title: fix(security,metadata-protocol): a packaged permission set's DELETE stops reporting a deletion it did not perform
body:
Fixes #19306

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set/{id}` on a **package-declared** set answered
`200 {"object":…,"id":…,"success":true}` and changed nothing. The identical call on an
environment-authored set really deletes. Both shipped a **byte-identical envelope**, so no
caller could act differently on the two cases: a UI fired a success toast and showed the row
again on refresh, on a *security-configuration* write.

The mechanical source, in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts`:
the write-through's delete leg opened with `let lastOutcome: any = true` and the loop body
could only ever assign `true` again, so no path could report anything else. The difference
was already named one line up — `logger.info('[security] permission set reset to its declared
baseline …')` — but it went to the log, never to the caller.

## What this does NOT change

The record surviving is the **design**, not the defect: an artifact-backed definition
tombstones its overlay (an ADR-0005 RESET) and the record re-projects to the declared body
instead of vanishing. The restore leg's own argument depends on that guarantee. This PR makes
the **answer** truthful; it does not make a packaged set deletable.

## The fix

1. `permission-set-projection.ts` — the delete leg reports how many of the addressed
   **records** actually went, read off the record itself rather than off the re-projection's
   counter. (That counter is not the fact: on a kernel wired to the ADR-0094 *awaited*
   projector — the production shape — `deleteMetaItem` has already retired the record, so the
   idempotent re-projection legitimately reports `deleted: 0` for a delete that really
   happened. Reading it would have answered `success: false` for **every** delete. The first
   draft did exactly that and the new pin's control leg caught it.)
2. `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` — `deleteData` maps that onto the already declared
   `success` key instead of hard-coding `true`.

⛔ **No spec change.** `DeleteDataResponseSchema` keeps its three keys; `success` is declared
"Whether deletion succeeded" and a record that is still there was not deleted. The `/meta`
door's `reset` discriminator was deliberately **not** moved onto this door — that is a
`packages/spec` widening and belongs to the spec lane, not to this PR.

⛔ **Not `false` from the middleware either.** The boolean arm's `false` is the driver
contract's "no row matched", which `deleteData` turns into `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` — about a
record the same caller can still GET. Zero rows removed is the engine delete result's other
declared arm and the only value that positively says "it is still there".

## On the wire

| case | before | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| packaged set | `200 {"success":true}`, row unchanged | `200 {"success":false}`, row unchanged |
| environment-authored set | `200 {"success":true}`, row gone | `200 {"success":true}`, row gone |
| unknown id | `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` |
| ordinary object | `200 {"success":true}`, row gone | `200 {"success":true}`, row gone |

## Evidence

**Live REST, `examples/app-showcase` booted `--fresh`, seeded platform admin over a cookie
session — an ordinary non-system caller.** The card's reading was taken against
`f93beea0a6`; this branch's base is `fade3da23`, so both legs were re-taken on today's tree.

BEFORE (base `fade3da23`, port 38913) — the defect reproduced:

```
DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set/ps_mua1tdbwu14gimg2   (showcase_auditor, managed_by=package)
  -> 200 {"object":"sys_permission_set","id":"ps_mua1tdbwu14gimg2","success":true}
GET  same id -> 200, same id, updated_at 2026-09-20T16:46:31.868Z (unchanged), row count 17 -> 17
```

BEFORE, negative control — an environment-authored set really deletes:

```
POST   /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set  {"name":"probe_env_set_19306"}  -> 201, rows 17 -> 18
DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set/ps_mua1uc5xypituh2j             -> 200 {"success":true}
       rows 18 -> 17 ;  GET the id -> 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND
```

AFTER (this branch, port 38914) — same two legs:

```
DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set/ps_mua26j2717zrru57   (showcase_member_default, managed_by=package)
  -> 200 {"object":"sys_permission_set","id":"ps_mua26j2717zrru57","success":false}
GET  same id -> 200, same id, updated_at 2026-09-20T16:56:45.823Z (unchanged), row count 17 -> 17
```

```
POST   /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set  {"name":"probe_env_set_19306_after"} -> 201, rows 17 -> 18
DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set/ps_mua276okvsajceez              -> 200 {"success":true}
       rows 18 -> 17 ;  GET the id -> 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND
DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set/ps_definitely_not_a_row          -> 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND
DELETE /api/v1/data/showcase_task/dckUaD8NSPulx3wv                      -> 200 {"success":true}, GET -> 404
```

⇒ the packaged leg is the only answer that moved; record survival, ids, `updated_at` and row
counts are identical before and after, and no delete became a no-op.

**Unit.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`
— plugin-security 115 files / 2234 tests passed, metadata-protocol 182 files (3 skipped) /
2601 tests passed (19 skipped). `typecheck` on both: exit 0.

**Reverse verification** (both on committed state, mutation proven on disk by
`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`'s anchor and blob counts, restored byte-identical — the
restored blob equals the HEAD blob in both cases):

| mutation | pin | result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `success: deleted !== 0` back to `success: true` (anchor x1 to x0, blob `01c0b69e23ad` to `2387a4ca325b`) | `protocol.record-not-found.test.ts` | 1 failed / 13 passed |
| the delete-leg outcome back to `opCtx.result = true` (anchor x1 to x0, blob `d55d579b1a48` to `51005a746830`) | `permission-set-projection.test.ts` | 1 failed / 66 passed |

Both restored: `git hash-object` equals `git rev-parse HEAD:path`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
derived 65 families from this diff; all 65 ran, all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`
(65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). Repo-wide `pnpm lint` ran unnarrowed: exit 0.
All readings at `9f1c8b100`.

## Acceptance notes

Noticed while measuring, deliberately **not** fixed here:

- `os data delete` in its default (non-JSON) format prints `Record deleted: {id}`
  unconditionally, so the human-readable CLI surface still reports a deletion for a packaged
  permission set even though its own `--format json` arm now forwards `deleted: false`
  correctly. Same defect family, different door — reported for filing, not carried here.
- `deleteManyData`'s per-row `success` was not audited on this card; the batch door is out of
  this card's scope.
- #19307 (the duplicate-name 409 in this same file carrying no `code`) is not addressed here
  and remains open — it is hard-serialised after this card and none of its lines were touched.

## 第二轮 —— 隔离契约复核打回一条阻塞项,已修(本节由认领席 `domain:services` 补写)

⚠️ 正文首轮由 dev 一次写成(dev ⛔ 不 PATCH 正文),因此以上描述的是**第一轮**的探针 —— 而那个探针正是复核判为阻塞的东西。本节是第二轮的记录,以 head `9de7b7b97` 为准。

### 被打回的缺陷:存活探针 fail-open

第一轮的探针走 `tryFind`,其尾为 `catch { return []; }` ⇒ 读**抛异常**时返回空数组,与「行不在」无法区分 ⇒ 该行被计为已删除 ⇒ 门口答 `200 {"success":true}`,**而记录还在原地**。

即:本 PR 要消灭的那个谎被原样保留,只是触发条件从「打包声明集」换成了「这一次读失败」。

### 修法

新增模块内 `probeRecordSurvival`(`permission-set-projection.ts:144`),返回三态 `'gone' | 'present' | 'unknown'`,`catch { return 'unknown'; }`。调用点 `:1385`:

```ts
const survival = await probeRecordSurvival(ql, 'sys_permission_set', row.id);
if (survival === 'unknown') { logger?.warn?.( /* 耐久通道:说明调用方被告知了什么、怎么落定 */ ); }
if (survival === 'gone') removed += 1;
```

⇒ **只有真正答复了的读才能产生 `gone`**;`unknown` 计为幸存(fail-closed),并在耐久通道报告一次。方向与先例写进了代码:同插件 `per-organization-catalog.ts` 的 `listSeedOrganizationIds` 早已写明同一条规则(零个组织是「没什么要种」,读不出来是「我们不知道」)。

探针的 context 与读法与 `tryFind` 逐字节同形(`seedCtx()`,不带 `transaction` 键),故复核已核准的事务语义不变 —— ambient 事务句柄照常承载。

### 本轮新增的钉子

- **单元 pin**:`a read-back that cannot ANSWER reports the record as NOT deleted (fail-closed)`。它只让**读回那一次**失败(目标解析与探针都按 id 读,靠顺序区分),并**先断言 `byIdReads >= 2`** —— 注入若没打中,测试变**红**而不是空绿。
- **端到端 pin ×2**:`showcase-permission-projection.dogfood.test.ts` 与 `two-doors-permission.dogfood.test.ts` 此前只断言 `status < 300`,信封回归它们照样全绿;现各加一行 `expect((await res.json())?.success, 'a reset does not report a deletion').toBe(false)`。

### 门禁面的变化

派生族集由 **65 → 69**(`packages/qa/dogfood` 进入改动集,新增 spec 的 `check:empty-state`、`check:liveness`、`check:strictness-ledger`、`check:variant-docs`),69 族全跑、全 exit 0;repo-wide `pnpm lint` 未收窄,exit 0。

### ⛔ 未改动、经复核核准后逐条现验

- `packages/spec/**`:**零改动**(`git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- packages/spec` 为空)。`Clause-②: no` 维持不变 —— 依 #16349 的方向裁决,「拉回已声明契约」不触条款②。
- `protocol.ts` 的另外两张未修面(`origin/main` 的 `:12518` batch 臂、`:13070` `deleteManyData`)**一字未动**,已另立 **#19412**(`domain:engine` 面)。
- `success: deleted !== 0` 与其上的 `deleted === false` → 404 分支与第一轮核准版本逐字节相同。

第一轮的实时 REST 前后读数仍然成立且未重取:本轮只改**读失败**这条路径,线上两条腿的行为未变,该路径由单元 pin 覆盖。

<sub>本节由 `domain:services` 席(`session_01AhQASwqJr2Z7XfGWUdvnbF`)补写,依 `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`「PR 正文 dev 只写一次…事后要改的报告点名改法,席位代写」。复核记录见卡上 `5751509468`。</sub>
